messages:
karim-people-ops: Heads-up: weve had a couple of employees ask about FSA carryover vs grace period during the upcoming benefits vendor change. Also one person asked if 401k loan repayments will continue uninterrupted. Can benefits/payroll confirm what actually migrates and what we need to action? @julia-benefits @noah-payroll

julia-benefits: Short version: FSA active balances and current plan elections will be exported, but vendor processes for carryover/grace vary. If someone has a plan with a $610 carryover it should carry, but if their plan uses a 2.5-month grace period the vendor may require manual adjudication for claims submitted after cutover. We need claim dates and receipts saved.

noah-payroll: On 401k loan repayments: payroll remits loan repayments as deduction lines in the payroll file. If payroll continues to send the loan deduction code unchanged, the new vendor will apply them to the outstanding loan balance. If a loan was originated pre-cutover and a repayment posts during blackout, we must ensure payroll file includes the loan_ref ID. Missing loan_ref => vendor may treat it as an additional contribution.

maya-hrops: Operational ask: what should managers tell employees who plan to submit FSA claims in the week of migration? Any templated language we can use?

julia-benefits: Suggestion text: "If you have FSA claims for services rendered before [cutover date], submit receipts by EOD [pre-cutover deadline] in the current portal. Claims submitted during the blackout may be delayed or require resubmission. Keep originals until claims are processed." Add a link to the claims upload guide: https://benefits.example.com/fsa-claims

karim-people-ops: Great. For loan_ref ID: where do managers find that? Can we surface it in offer/onboarding docs?

noah-payroll: Loan_ref appears on the employees paystub and in the payroll system under deductions -> loans. For new hires with active loans (rare), include the loan_ref in the new-hire payroll ticket. Template snippet for payroll tickets:

```
Employee: Mateo Ruiz (ID 45231)
Action: Add ongoing 401k loan repayment $150 per pay
Loan ref: LOAN-2022-78
Deduction code: RD401K_LOAN
```

julia-benefits: Also: FSA plan types. If someone elected a Limited FSA for HSA eligibility, that election will be noted. During cutover we should ensure the FSA type flag is exported; otherwise employee could be temporarily misclassified for HSA contributions. If that happens, HR should submit an FSA type correction ticket with code: FSA_TYPE_FIX.

benefits-bot: Reminder: Benefits vendor migration blackout: 2026-05-14 18:00 PT -> 2026-05-16 06:00 PT. Only emergency payroll tickets accepted during blackout. See migration FAQ: https://benefits.example.com/migration-faq

maya-hrops: Thanks all. I'll add the templates and the manager script to the onboarding checklist and nudge recruiting to include the paystub loan_ref pointer for rehired employees. Anything else? :spiral_note_pad:
